_about: Vernehmlassung documents added by hand to consultations.db (search_stack/consultation_archive.py, source curated_wayback). Each entry was read off the Federal Office of Justice's consultation list pages (www.admin.ch/bj/vernehm/vernehm{d,f,i}.htm) in the Wayback Machine during the 2026-10-20 office-page census (runbooks/materialien_completeness.md), and each archived file was fetched once and checked to be the PDF the page names. Labels are the page's own link texts, verbatim (the French 'apport' is the page's). snapshot = the Wayback capture of the file (null: linked, never captured); source_page_url = the capture of the list page that links it. Jonas, 2026-10-20: add exactly these two; the office-page crawl itself is not a source.
